outro.line: Save this before your next salary call

hook.title: Salary call in *2 hours* and I *freeze* on the number

beats.text: My salary call is in two hours, and I freeze on the number.
Confidence won't fix that. A number with proof will.
You rehearsed five times. Said 'fifteen' once.
Step one. Search the real range. With sources.

panel.title: Search real ranges
panel.html:
UX designer, 4 years, Denver. Real salary range? Cite sources.
Range: $78k to $96k3 sources linkedYou're at $80k
+15% = $92kinside the range

beats.text: My friend Jess makes way more.
Step two. Tell me to ask you questions first.

panel.title: Make it ask first
panel.html:
Ask me 5 questions before you help.
What did you ship this year?Any numbers on it?Your walk-away number?
Your proof

Checkout redesign. Drop-offs down 22%.

beats.text: I redesigned checkout. That was it.
Step three. Voice mode. I play a tough recruiter.

panel.title: Rehearse it out loud
panel.html:
Budget's tight this year. What number did you have in mind?
Maybe... whatever's fair?froze
Ninety-two thousand.said it

beats.text: Budget's tight this year. What number?
Step four. One line. On a card by your laptop.

panel.title: One-line script
panel.html:
Based on market data and cutting checkout drop-offs by 22%, I'm asking for $92,000.
then stop talking
READY

beats.text: They said yes. In four seconds.
Four seconds means they had more.
